title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes VI
notes: The designer's sixth Stinkyscape+ balance pass (#4440). Resources: Axnit, Narcor and Red Narcor sell for 1, 2 and 2 less at each end of their base range, Radiant twice that (R4440000); Spice pays about 15% more, 5 to 15, Radiant 9 to 29 (R4440001), and the AI holds a card that pays Credits at half its hand price, so it sells Spice more often (R4440002); Abandoned Spice Tower's Activate deals 2. Profe Yates is (2) 3/7 Tribute 1, its Cry summons a random Trap, its Death shuffles in Profe Yates Prime, and it exiles nothing (R4440003); the Prime, S+ #4.1, is a token with Yates's old text at (2) 6/6 (R4440004). Cards: Selective Enrollment (6), xxFreshJack Tribute 2 with Float reduces Tribute requirement, Jogg's Box 8 casts, Raven Tribute 2 2/2, Honey Badger 2/5, Black Hole's base face pulling at the end of each turn (R4440050), Chaos Accelerator (3), ZolarKeth Tribute 2, the Beams 2%4, 4%8 and 6%12, Crawler 2/1, Otherworldly Nightmare (4), Starfleet Commander 7/7, Jlockeed's Weapons +1%+3, Stratos Swarm summoning 7 (R4440051), Galaxy Tribute 3, Mind Melt and Last Hurrah Tradable with Last Hurrah's base face giving 4 cards Flashback, Operation Omega (1) Embiggened (3), Second Wind's +1%+2 mana per turn (R4440052), The Last Voyage launching at the end of each turn (R4440053), Tommy Tempo's +1/+1 per mana lost (R4440054), Double Counting (3) with a free Activate, Joint Filing's Activate Discover (R4440055); each changed script keeps its v0.6.9i one (R767000). Rulings R4440000-R4440004 and R4440050-R4440055.

player.title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes VI
new: Profe Yates Prime, a token Profe Yates shuffles into your deck when it dies: (2) 6/6 (Radiant 12/12), with Profe Yates's old Cry: exile a permanent with M, O, U, S and E in its name and text, then summon a random Trap (Radiant: three).
balance: Axnit sells for 3–13 Credits (Radiant 6–26), down from 4–14 (Radiant 8–28).
Narcor sells for 8–19 Credits (Radiant 16–38), down from 10–21 (Radiant 20–42).
Red Narcor sells for 14–30 Credits (Radiant 28–60), down from 16–32 (Radiant 32–64).
Spice gives 5–15 Credits (Radiant 9–29), up from 4–13 (Radiant 8–25).
Abandoned Spice Tower's Activate deals you 2 damage, down from 4.

Profe Yates costs (2), down from (4), and is 3/7 (Radiant 6/14), from 6/6 (Radiant 12/12); it gains Tribute 1, its Cry summons a random Trap (Radiant: a random Radiant Trap), and its new Death shuffles a Profe Yates Prime (Radiant: a Radiant one) into your deck. It no longer exiles.
Selective Enrollment costs (6), up from (5).
xxFreshJack has Tribute 2, up from Tribute 1, and gains "Float reduces Tribute requirement by 1." on both faces.
Jogg's Box casts 8 random Spells (Radiant 16), down from 10 (Radiant 20).
Raven has Tribute 2, up from Tribute 1, and is 2/2 (Radiant 4/4), up from 1/1 (Radiant 2/2).
Honey Badger is 2/5 (Radiant 4/10), down from 4/6 (Radiant 8/12).
Black Hole draws each player's permanents closer at the end of their turn instead of the start; its Radiant face still pulls your opponent's at the start of theirs.
Chaos Accelerator costs (3), up from (2).
ZolarKeth has Tribute 2, up from Tribute 1.
Beam v5 deals 6 damage (Radiant 12), down from 7 (Radiant 14); Beam v4 deals 4 (Radiant 8), down from 5 (Radiant 10); Beam v3 deals 2 (Radiant 4), down from 3 (Radiant 6).
Crawler is 2/1 (Radiant 4/2), down from 3/1 (Radiant 6/2).
Otherworldly Nightmare costs (4), up from (3).
Starfleet Commander is 7/7 (Radiant 14/14), down from 9/9 (Radiant 18/18).
Jlockeed's Weapons gives your Units +1 Attack (Radiant +3), down from +2 (Radiant +4).
Stratos Swarm summons 7 Stratos instead of filling your board.
Galaxy has Tribute 3, up from Tribute 2.
Mind Melt is Tradable.
Last Hurrah is Tradable; its base face now gives 4 random cards in your hand Flashback, and its Radiant face gives every card in your hand Flashback.
Operation Omega costs (1), down from (2), and its Embiggened price is (3), down from (4).
Second Wind also gives you +1 mana per turn (Radiant +2).
The Last Voyage launches a random Starship at the end of each of your turns instead of the start.
Tommy Tempo's Cry gives +1/+1 (Radiant +2/+2) per mana lost, up from +1 Health (Radiant +2 Health).
Double Counting costs (3), up from (2), and its Activate is free on both faces.
Joint Filing's Cry is replaced with "Activate: Discover a card with a Start of turn or End of turn effect."
changes: The computer opponent plays Spice for its Credits more often.
